kurz: Either the egg has curdled or the starch has formed lumps.
bild_im_kopf: Like scrambled egg in the custard.

ursachen.warum: Above about 80 °C the egg yolk curdles into [[krume|crumbs]].
fix: Pour straight through a sieve into a cold bowl and smooth with a stick blender
Next time use a water bath and stir constantly

ursachen.warum: Starch added straight to hot milk forms lumps.
fix: Mix the starch with a little cold milk first

ursachen.warum: At the bottom of the pan it gets hotter and curdles first.
fix: Stir constantly, across the bottom too
